emails.subject: Re: Re: Re: Re: Fall menu boards - round 3 notes
emails.body:
Thanks all, catching up on this thread.

> On Oct 24, Leah (Saltmarsh) wrote:
> Attached is round 3 with the pumpkin illustration moved left and the price column widened.
>> On Oct 23, Dana wrote:
>> Love the direction. Can we try the illustration on the left? Also Marcus wants the oat milk surcharge smaller.
>>> On Oct 22, Leah wrote:
>>> Here are the round 2 boards. We kept the kraft texture and swapped the serif.
>>>> On Oct 21, Dana wrote:
>>>> Round 1 notes: logo feels small, coffee prices hard to read from the line.

Anyway the illustration placement is great now, Marcus agrees, and the kraft texture is perfect. One small thing on the cold brew line, can we make it 'Cold Brew (16oz)' instead of 'Cold Brew Lg'. Otherwise no notes.

Oh and sorry, almost forgot, the print shop told me this morning they need the final print-ready PDFs by 9am TOMORROW (Tuesday) or we lose our slot and the boards won't be up for the Nov 1 launch. Can someone confirm you can hit that?

Thanks!
Dana
Harbor & Pine Coffee

emails.subject: This is unacceptable
emails.body:
I was promised the booking page would be live LAST FRIDAY. It's Monday. I've had three customers call asking why they can't book the sunset tour and I'm losing money every day this isn't working. Nobody answered my call Saturday either.

I need someone to tell me TODAY exactly when this will be fixed or I'm going to start looking for another agency. Frankly I'm considering asking for part of the deposit back.

Rick Calloway
Owner, Lowcountry Kayak Co
912-555-0143
